decisions.reason: Specifies paste_image/paste_file with (2),(3)… before the extension, smallest free integer seeded from the taken-name set within the batch, renaming scoped to the paste ingestion site (or an explicit paste-only origin flag) before validateItems and record creation, drop/picker untouched.

Identifies the live snapshot occurrences (read at rename time) unioned with current-batch allocations as authoritative, and explains the alive-subscription retires records on any momentary empty snapshot while the attachment remains, so records can supplement but never replace live state.

Explains the stale label from the captured x-cache HIT/age 178 response whose max tag is v0.2.9 plus renderCurrentChip(tag) printing the fetched value; the corrected rule compares semantically against running PLUGIN_VERSION and shows the running version whenever remote ≤ running, never an older fetched tag.

A1/A2 assert same-batch and sequential pastes keep distinct names, A6 fires the transient-empty-snapshot retirement and asserts a live occurrence still blocks the name with an emptied records Map, A5 locks drop/picker names, and B1–B4 cover stale/equal and newer remote tags with concrete assertions.

Bumps and verifies PLUGIN_VERSION against package.json in the shipped lib artifact (B6), runs node --check on the final files plus behavioral tests, and explains delivery as user-driven re-install/replacement of lib with a browser hard refresh, explicitly noting the chip is a prompt and there is no host-side update endpoint.
